name: Sausage, Egg, Beans
notes: Sausage macros are from the label (per 3: 130 kcal, 12g protein, 1g carbs, 8g fat), scaled up to 4. Bean figures are from the label (whole 398ml tin: 140 kcal, 7g protein, 28g carbs, 0.5g fat), halved; that's low for a whole tin, so the label may really be giving a smaller serving. Egg macros are estimated from typical values.
